summary_1line: Sita becomes enchanted by a magical golden deer and urges Rama to capture it despite Lakshmana warning it is the demon Maricha in disguise.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant golden deer studded with jewels prances through the forest clearing while Sita watches in wonder among flowering trees.
Sita excitedly points toward the glittering deer while Rama and Lakshmana turn to look, bows in hand at the forest edge.
The enchanted deer glows in the forest light, its gem-studded horns and silver skin shining as it circles teasingly before Sita.
